title: The Physical Book Camera Scanner
target_audience: Physical book buyers, students with paper handouts

beats.name: The Scroll-Stop Hook
beats.inflection: [Intense Whisper / Shocked Eye Contact / Sudden Peak]
beats.text: You can literally point your phone camera at physical books now.
beats.visual_action: Over-the-shoulder shot: Phone camera hovering over open paperback novel.

beats.name: The Setup & Entities
beats.tone: rapid-fire matter-of-fact delivery and fast tempo
beats.role: Everyday scenario where hands are tied
beats.text: I had this heavy paperback I wanted to read, but my hands were completely busy prepping dinner.
beats.visual_action: Creator chopping vegetables on cutting board with book propped up awkwardly.

beats.name: The Dramatic Twist
beats.tone: incredulous and shocked with building excitement
beats.text: I snapped one quick photo using VoiceReader App, and in under two seconds, it turned the printed page into crystal-clear speech with zero robotic pauses or awkward mispronunciations.
beats.visual_action: Phone snaps photo in app; instant OCR processing banner turns immediately into smooth audio playback.

beats.name: The Moral Dilemma & Question
beats.tone: amused deadpan and engaging rising intonation
beats.role: Viral Engagement Engine: prompt debate in comments
beats.text: Are physical books becoming obsolete, or do you still prefer holding paper pages?
beats.visual_action: Creator holds paperback in one hand, phone in the other, smiling.
